title: 联想CFO：全球布局与盈利增长支撑扩张
speaker: Winston Chang

segments.en: How do you control yourself in terms of because it just seems that the constraint to growth is simply your capacity to grow
segments.zh: 你如何控制自己？因为增长的制约似乎就是你的扩张能力

segments.en: Your you know the way you fund growth
segments.zh: 你知道，你为增长融资的方式

segments.en: Clearly it's visible to you that demand is there for several years
segments.zh: 你显然看到未来几年的需求

segments.en: Is it I don't know like how is that conversation within you and you know your executive committee and how you deal with
segments.zh: 你和执行委员会如何讨论，如何处理？

segments.en: Fundraising and being able to make sure you have the money but also not invest too much yeah
segments.zh: 融资，确保有资金，但又不过度扩张

segments.en: So absolutely so I look at it in terms of our current manufacturing facility
segments.zh: 当然，我看我们现有的制造设施

segments.en: We actually have the broadest purple and we're well diversified in the key geographies that we have so we can have a manufacturer
segments.zh: 我们拥有最广泛的布局，在关键地区多元化，可以制造

segments.en: Devices and infrastructure in any major current continents that we operate in so I think that's very important
segments.zh: 在我们运营的任何主要大洲，设备与基础设施都能制造，这很重要

segments.en: So we're already well placed in terms of our global business sure our geographies actually recorded record revenue
segments.zh: 我们的全球业务已经布局良好，各地区都创下收入纪录

segments.en: So we have balanced growth so that gives me confidence that we can invest in where we need to invest in
segments.zh: 我们增长均衡，这让我有信心在需要的地方投入

segments.en: ISG's now doing very well and it's profitable so we can invest additionally there as well and we have been
segments.zh: 基础设施方案集团现在表现很好，而且盈利，我们可以额外投入，我们一直在做

segments.en: We acquired a storage business to continue that product portfolio set
segments.zh: 我们收购了一家存储业务，以完善产品组合

segments.en: And I think that integration and the results of that is many years to come in terms of where that was
segments.zh: 整合的成果将在未来多年显现

segments.en: But in the meantime servers is where it is majority contributing a lot of the business growth
segments.zh: 但与此同时，服务器是业务增长的主要贡献者
